bills.title: Counter-Terrorism Legislation Amendment (Prohibited Hate Symbols and Other Measures) Bill 2023

name: The majority voted in favour of keeping items 3, 4 and 5 of [schedule 4](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;db=LEGISLATION;id=legislation%2Fbills%2Fr7048_first-reps%2F0004;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Fbills%2Fr7048_first-reps%2F0000%22;rec=0) as they are, which means they will remain unchanged. This vote was put after NSW Senator [David Shoebridge](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/nsw/david_shoebridge) (Greens) proposed that [they should be opposed](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2023-12-06.194.1). Senator Shoebridge was seeing to retain relevant [sunsetting provisions](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sunset_provision).
